revenue_accrual.notes: The only token "revenue" is the burn when developers pay for cycles: about $1.9M a year on a $1.24B network. Governance mints roughly 20× that in new ICP each year as voting rewards, before node-provider rewards. So burn does not offset dilution and nothing flows to an unstaked holder. Score **2**, which **trips the Revenue gate**.
